entity.name: EmbeddedOS Research Foundation
entity.description: EmbeddedOS Research Foundation is a US 501(c)(3) nonprofit developing MIT-licensed open-source real-time operating system (RTOS) and secure bootloader firmware for resource-constrained microcontrollers (RISC-V RV32IM, ARM Cortex-M). Our mission is to provide formally verified, open-source firmware infrastructure for critical embedded systems in medical devices, industrial control, and IoT.

projects.name: eos
projects.description: MIT-licensed RTOS for RISC-V RV32IM and ARM Cortex-M. 15.8 KB flash, 84 board descriptors, AES-128/256, SHA-256/512, Ed25519 secure boot. Deployed in medical devices, water treatment, and industrial control systems.

plans.name: Sustaining Sponsor
plans.description: Sustain ongoing development of eos RTOS and eBoot secure bootloader — formal verification, RISC-V/ARM platform support, CI/CD, documentation.
